О ПОРЯДКЕ РАССМОТРЕНИЯ ОБРАЩЕНИЙ: ON THE PROCEDURE FOR CONSIDERING APPEALS
ГРАЖДАН РОССИЙСКОЙ ФЕДЕРАЦИИ: BY CITIZENS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
Статья 1. Сфера применения настоящего Фе: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
1. Настоящим Федеральным законом регулир: 1. This Federal Law governs legal relations connected with a citizen of the Russian Federation (also referred to below as a citizen) exercising the right, guaranteed by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, to appeal to state bodies and local self-government bodies. It also establishes the procedure by which state bodies, local self-government bodies and officials consider citizens' appeals.
2. Установленный настоящим Федеральным з: 2. The procedure for considering citizens' appeals established by this Federal Law applies to all citizens' appeals except those to be considered under a procedure established by federal constitutional laws or other federal laws.
3. Установленный настоящим Федеральным з: 3. The procedure for considering citizens' appeals established by this Federal Law applies to legal relations connected with considering appeals by foreign citizens and stateless persons, except where an international treaty of the Russian Federation or a federal law provides otherwise.
4. Установленный настоящим Федеральным з: 4. The procedure established by this Federal Law for state bodies, local self-government bodies and officials to consider citizens' appeals applies to legal relations arising when those bodies and officials consider appeals by associations of citizens, including legal entities. It also applies to legal relations arising when state or municipal institutions, other organisations or their officials exercising functions of public significance consider appeals by citizens or associations of citizens, including legal entities.
1. Граждане имеют право обращаться лично: 1. Citizens have the right to make an appeal in person and to submit individual and collective appeals, including appeals by associations of citizens and legal entities, to state bodies, local self-government bodies and their officials and to state or municipal institutions and other organisations entrusted with functions of public significance, and their officials.
2. Граждане реализуют право на обращение: 2. Citizens exercise the right to appeal freely and voluntarily. Exercising this right must not infringe the rights or freedoms of other persons.
3. Рассмотрение обращений граждан осущес: 3. Citizens' appeals are considered free of charge.
Статья 3. Правовое регулирование правоот: Article 3. Law governing consideration of citizens' appeals
1. Правоотношения, связанные с рассмотре: 1. Legal relations connected with considering citizens' appeals are governed by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, international treaties of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law and other federal laws.
2. Законы и иные нормативные правовые ак: 2. The laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may make provision for protecting citizens' right to appeal, including safeguards supplementing those established by this Federal Law.
Статья 4. Основные термины, используемые: Article 4. Principal terms used in this Federal Law
Для целей настоящего Федерального закона: For the purposes of this Federal Law, the following principal terms apply:
1) обращение гражданина (далее - обращен: 1) a citizen's appeal (hereinafter an appeal) is a proposal, application or complaint sent to a state body, local self-government body or official in writing or as an electronic document, or an oral appeal by a citizen to a state body or local self-government body. Unless this Federal Law provides otherwise, an electronic document is submitted through the federal state information system Unified Portal of State and Municipal Services (Functions) (hereinafter the Unified Portal), another information system of a state body or local self-government body, or the official website of such a body on the internet. The system or website must provide for identification or authentication of citizens, or both;
2) предложение - рекомендация гражданина: 2) a proposal is a citizen's recommendation to improve laws or other regulatory legal acts, the operation of state bodies and local self-government bodies, social relations, or socioeconomic or other areas of public and social activity;
3) заявление - просьба гражданина о соде: 3) an application is a citizen's request for assistance in exercising their constitutional rights and freedoms or those of another person, a report of a violation of laws or other regulatory legal acts or of shortcomings in the work of state bodies, local self-government bodies or officials, or criticism of the activities of those bodies or officials;
4) жалоба - просьба гражданина о восстан: 4) a complaint is a citizen's request to restore or protect their infringed rights, freedoms or legitimate interests, or those of another person;

Статья 5. Права гражданина при рассмотре: Article 5. Rights of a citizen when an appeal is considered
1. Личный прием граждан в государственны: 1. State bodies and local self-government bodies receive citizens in person through their heads or persons authorised to do so. Citizens shall be informed of the place and the days and hours set for reception.
2. При личном приеме гражданин предъявля: 2. At an in-person reception, the citizen shall present an identity document.
3. Содержание устного обращения заноситс: 3. The substance of an oral appeal shall be entered in the citizen's in-person reception record. If the facts and circumstances stated in an oral appeal are clear and require no additional verification, the reply may be given orally during the reception with the citizen's consent. This shall be recorded in the reception record. In other cases a written reply addressing the merits of the questions raised in the appeal shall be given.
4. Письменное обращение, принятое в ходе: 4. A written appeal accepted during an in-person reception shall be registered and considered in accordance with this Federal Law.
5. В случае, если в обращении содержатся: 5. If the appeal raises issues outside the competence of the state body, local self-government body or official concerned, the citizen shall be advised where and under what procedure to appeal.
6. В ходе личного приема гражданину може: 6. During an in-person reception, the citizen may be refused further consideration of an appeal if they have previously received a reply addressing the merits of the questions raised in it.
7. Отдельные категории граждан в случаях: 7. In the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, certain categories of citizens have the right to priority in-person reception.
Статья 14. Контроль за соблюдением поряд: Article 14. Oversight of compliance with the procedure for considering appeals
Государственные органы, органы местного: State bodies, local self-government bodies and officials shall oversee compliance with the procedure for considering appeals within their respective competence, analyse the substance of incoming appeals and take measures to identify promptly and eliminate the causes of infringements of citizens' rights, freedoms and legitimate interests.
Статья 15. Ответственность за нарушение: Article 15. Liability for violation of this Federal Law
Лица, виновные в нарушении настоящего Фе: Persons guilty of violating this Federal Law shall incur the liability provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
Статья 16. Возмещение причиненных убытко: Article 16. Compensation for losses and recovery of expenses incurred in considering appeals
1. Гражданин имеет право на возмещение у: 1. A citizen is entitled, by court decision, to compensation for loss and non-pecuniary harm caused by an unlawful act or omission by a state body, local self-government body or official when considering an appeal.
2. В случае, если гражданин указал в обр: 2. If a citizen has knowingly stated false information in an appeal, expenses incurred by a state body, local self-government body or official in considering that appeal may be recovered from the citizen by court decision.
